item.title: Road construction announced for section of Hwy. 486 beginning March 2

item.title: City of Natchitoches issues burn ban amid dry conditions
item.description: City officials have issued a burn ban for the City of Natchitoches due to dry and unsafe burning conditions, along with an increase in fires reported throughout the parish and surrounding areas.
